what: Fix request (01240 was an FYI and was closed): round 7c (adc8bbbf04) blaze-query --lib still fails tests::a_warm_miss_allocates_at_most_a_segment (src/tests.rs:1226), 2 allocations / 8241 bytes against a budget of 1. It is the crate-root store engine (db.open(View), pinned.get::<Double>), not db/: all 41 db:: tests pass. The 8241 bytes look like one segment plus a second small allocation on a warm miss at n >= 32. Either the warm-miss path allocates something it used to reuse, or the budget is wrong; it must not be left red.

history.note: Same failure as 01146. The 1 extra byte was len(a)s String key decoded by cbor::from_slice each time verifying double(a) reruns len from its slot bytes. Fixed in crates/blaze-query/src/lib.rs: KeySource::Bytes is gone, a key read back from bytes is decoded once into Database::keys (dropped with its slot), and tests.rs extends a_key_is_kept_once_and_runs_again_by_its_bytes. In round 8 (7abbb7252c); round 7c predates it.
